subject: New shared skill: Coding Agent delegation (required reading)
body:
FA has published a new shared skill file in the journal repo: docs/skills/fa-coding-agent-delegation.md

This covers everything the Forge team has learned about delegating work to the GitHub Copilot Coding Agent. Read it before creating any GitHub Issues intended for the Coding Agent. The skill file includes issue templates, known failure modes, and quality rules.

Key takeaway for Grind agents: the Coding Agent only works on personal repos (marcusash/*) with ubuntu-latest runners. Enterprise repos are blocked by runner policy. If you need to delegate work to the Coding Agent, coordinate with FA on repo setup.

The skill file lives in the journal repo at docs/skills/fa-coding-agent-delegation.md.
